about.eyebrow: Mechanical Engineering — Stevens Institute of Technology
about.bodyP1: I'm a mechanical engineering student at Stevens Institute of Technology, and most of what I know about design I learned by making the part first and drawing it second. I spend my week split between the machine shop and the CAD workstation — running mills and lathes on one side, modeling and tolerancing on the other — which is exactly the loop I want to keep running in aerospace: design something, understand how it's actually manufactured, and make it better because of that.
about.bodyP2: As President of Stevens' SAE BAJA Racing Team, I collaborate with every subteam to design, analyze, and manufacture 400+ parts, and I led the acquisition of a $100,000 fiber laser cutter for student engineering organizations. As Head TA for a manufacturing course, I teach GD&T, CMM, CAM, and DFM to the next group of students coming through the shop I work in.

expertise.text: Leading teams, budgets, and sponsors for student engineering orgs.

bullets: Machine stainless and aluminum parts for high-speed imaging use in a hypersonic wind tunnel.
Designed, manufactured, and assembled 20+ parts for a biomass 3D printer motion system.
Troubleshot and repaired 30 3D printers, 3 mills, 2 lathes, and 2 welders.
Consult with students and professors on Design for Manufacturability (DFM).
Led 10+ machining labs on CNC mills and lathes, GD&T, CMM, metrology, welding, and cold forming.
Expand and update content, style, and flow of 10+ lectures.
Instruct in weekly lectures on manufacturing, measuring, and design theory and techniques.
Researched metamaterials, dispersion diagrams, evanescent waves, non-reciprocity, and vibrational dynamics in elastic materials.
Co-designed a roton structure to restrict vibrational energy to a narrow frequency band.
Assembled and calibrated a surface-mount machine.
Compiled all research into a poster and presented it to a panel of experts.

projects.title: SAE BAJA Racing Team
paragraphs: Collaborate with all subteams to design, analyze, and manufacture 400+ parts.
Spearheaded the acquisition of a $100,000 fiber laser cutter: 5 months from initial proposal to machine delivery.
Managed a $30,000 semesterly budget, wrote sponsorship packets, and applied for grants and subsidies.
Present the club's objectives to 100+ students at least twice a semester.

projects.title: Brakes & Pedals
paragraphs: Led design, research, manufacturing, and testing of 20+ parts for the braking system and pedals.
Developed calculators for pedal length, line pressure, caliper size, and master cylinder size.
Also served as Secretary of Recording, managing schedules and logistics for 20+ members.

projects.title: Drivetrain Guarding
paragraphs: Researched, designed, manufactured, and welded aluminum drivetrain component guarding.

projects.title: Autonomous Boat Design
paragraphs: Led a student team through planning and rapid prototyping of an autonomous boat, designing the hull and internal wiring architecture.
Used CFD and FEA to iterate 3D-printed hull and electronics housing designs, ending in a full technical report and presentation.
